**Blues Scale in the Key of A**

| Scale Degree | Note | Interval from Previous Note |
|--------------|------|-----------------------------|
| 1 (Root)     | **A** | — |
| b3 (Minor 3rd)| **C** | 3 semitones (minor third) |
| 4 (Perfect 4th)| **D** | 2 semitones (major second) |
| b5 (Blue note)| **Eb** | 1 semitone (minor second) |
| 5 (Perfect 5th)| **E** | 1 semitone (minor second) |
| b7 (Minor 7th)| **G** | 3 semitones (minor third) |

**Pattern of Intervals (in semitones)**  
`3 – 2 – 1 – 1 – 3`

So the A blues scale is:

```
A – C – D – Eb – E – G
```

This is a pentatonic scale (root, minor third, fourth, fifth, minor seventh) with an added “blue” note (the flattened fifth).
